description: Composite figure comparing 3D cellular-automaton (CA) simulation with experimental/reconstructed DRX results for low-alloy steel at 850 °C. (a) Line plot at 850 °C_0.01 s⁻¹: x-axis True strain (0.0–0.9), left y-axis Average grain size (µm, 25–150), right y-axis DRX fraction (0.0–1.0); three series — pink circles 'Average grain size(3D CA)', black dashed 'DRX fraction(Eq.(45))', blue stars 'DRX fraction(3D CA)'; endpoints annotated 84.98% DRX and 34.53 µm AGS. (b) Identical layout at 850 °C_1 s⁻¹, annotated 49.59% DRX and 65.87 µm AGS. Six reconstruction maps follow, all with 100 µm scale bars: colour IPF orientation maps labelled 'Side section: 34.01±4.71 µm' (0.01 s⁻¹) and 'Side section: 61.38±7.41 µm' (1 s⁻¹), with a 001/101/111 colour triangle; DRX-fraction maps labelled 'DRX fraction: 79.3%' and 'DRX fraction: 42.8%' with a 0–15 colour bar; and striated '2D(YZ surface)' maps labelled 32.94 µm / 76.4% and 59.08 µm / 38.7%. '0.9 strain' is stamped on the side-section maps. Together the panels show that simulated and reconstructed grain size and DRX fraction are mutually consistent and that the lower strain rate produces a higher DRX fraction and a finer, less banded structure.

observations.observation: At 850 °C_0.01 s⁻¹ the DRX fraction (3D CA) rises monotonically with true strain and is annotated to reach 84.98% at 0.9 strain.
At 850 °C_0.01 s⁻¹ the average grain size (3D CA) falls monotonically with strain from ~145 µm toward the annotated 34.53 µm at 0.9 strain.
At 850 °C_1 s⁻¹ the DRX fraction (3D CA) rises more slowly and is annotated to reach 49.59%, with average grain size annotated at 65.87 µm.
Both plots use the legend entries 'Average grain size(3D CA)', 'DRX fraction(Eq.(45))' and 'DRX fraction(3D CA)', i.e. a computed DRX curve from Eq.(45) is compared with the 3D CA result.
The 'Side section' IPF maps are labelled 34.01±4.71 µm for the 0.01 s⁻¹ condition and 61.38±7.41 µm for the 1 s⁻¹ condition, both stamped '0.9 strain'.
The DRX-fraction maps are labelled 'DRX fraction: 79.3%' and 'DRX fraction: 42.8%', the higher value corresponding to the lower strain rate.
The 2D(YZ surface) reconstructions are labelled 32.94 µm / 76.4% and 59.08 µm / 38.7%, matching the lower- and higher-strain-rate conditions respectively.
Every microstructure panel carries a 100 µm scale bar and the IPF maps carry a 001/101/111 orientation colour triangle.
The caption states the figure compares DRX fraction and grain size between experimental and simulated results at 850 °C at strain rates 0.01 s⁻¹ and 1 s⁻¹.
The citing text states the simulated DRX fraction initially increased slowly and was then rapidly accelerated, then slowed as most of the matrix was refined (Fig. 12a).

The citing text states that increasing strain rate reduced DRX nucleation and growth, causing a significant decline in DRX fraction; at 850 °C and 0.01 s⁻¹ the experimental matrix was still elongated.

The citing text states that the simulated 2D (YZ surface) and 3D AGS and DRX fraction closely matched the reconstructed results, with the gap between section and 3D decreasing at the lower strain rate.

subfigures.description: Line plot for 850 °C_0.01 s⁻¹ labelled '3D'; x-axis True strain 0.0–0.9, left y-axis Average grain size (µm) 25–150, right y-axis DRX fraction 0.0–1.0. Legend: 'Average grain size(3D CA)' (pink circles/dashed), 'DRX fraction(Eq.(45))' (black dashed), 'DRX fraction(3D CA)' (blue stars/dashed). Endpoints annotated 84.98% (blue) and 34.53 µm (pink).
Line plot for 850 °C_1 s⁻¹ labelled '3D' with identical axes and legend to (a). DRX fraction rises more slowly and reaches 49.59% (annotated), average grain size ends at 65.87 µm (annotated).

Colour IPF orientation map labelled 'Side section: 34.01±4.71 µm' with '0.9 strain', 100 µm scale bar, and a 001/101/111 orientation colour triangle; equiaxed, fully recrystallised multi-coloured grains.
Colour IPF orientation map labelled 'Side section: 61.38±7.41 µm' with '0.9 strain' and 100 µm scale bar; strongly banded/elongated grains with green bands alternating with finer coloured grains.
DRX-fraction map labelled 'DRX fraction: 79.3%' with a 0–15 colour bar (blue→green→yellow→red) and 100 µm scale bar; large contiguous green DRX regions in a blue matrix.
DRX-fraction map labelled 'DRX fraction: 42.8%' with the same 0–15 colour bar and 100 µm scale bar; yellow/red DRX bands along the lower part of the field within a blue-green matrix.
'2D(YZ surface)' reconstruction labelled 32.94 µm and 76.4% with 100 µm scale bar; dense multi-coloured grain map.
'2D(YZ surface)' reconstruction labelled 59.08 µm and 38.7% with 100 µm scale bar; map rich in white (unindexed/void) regions between coloured grain bands.
